concerns.text: The plan lists `cost_metrics.csv` as an output (see the “Expected Outputs” table) but there is no corresponding JSON‑schema contract in `contracts/` (no `cost_metric.schema.yaml`). This creates a mismatch between the plan and the contract set.
The plan mentions `sensitivity_conformal.csv` (coverage‑sweep results) yet no contract file for this CSV is present in `contracts/`. It is unclear which schema (if any) should validate this file.

The plan refers to `statistical_report.csv` but the `contracts/` directory contains two similar schemas (`stats.schema.yaml` and `statistics.schema.yaml`). The plan does not specify which schema the file must conform to, leading to ambiguity.
